name: pair-bridge
description: Use local models through PAIR with unlimited empty-answer retries, memory-aware loading, local result logs, structured output and concurrent jobs.

interface.shortDescription: Consult and manage local models through PAIR.
interface.longDescription: Retry empty answers without a count limit, preserve a measured 1 GiB memory reserve, export local request results, inspect capabilities and start concurrent jobs.
defaultPrompt: Use pair_devices and pair_list to inspect installed local models.
Use pair_smart_ask for a bounded task with an installed model.
Use pair_capabilities, then start pair_job_start on different PCs before polling pair_job_status.
